I was remote working in Chiangmai way back in March and found this little slice of heaven near my condominium. Although I was not a clinic patient, I visited its little café regularly for the peace and quiet it offers. The place is usually not crowded on weekday afternoons, so I was able to work on my laptop there without interruptions too.

In time, I got to know Ploy, the lovely waitress, and had great conversations with Paul, the concierge. These local experiences really made my stay in Chiangmai a memorable one. Although the café doesn’t serve food, Ploy makes awesome drinks like pink milk and my favourite milk shakes.

One afternoon, I happened to witness an unreasonable, probably drunk, customer making a scene at the clinic. Seeing how Paul and the doctors calm the guy down in a professional manner was pretty impressive. If I ever need a dentist in Chiangmai, I’d definitely book one at this clinic!
